name: Romance Season
description: The season of love in the Tundra, with three sub events: Petals of Desire, the Silverfrost Shop, and Bloom Battle.

phases.name: Petals of Desire
phases.description: Complete daily missions (reset at 00:00 UTC) to earn Flower Points and unlock the reward track. After all rewards are claimed, each extra 500 points gives an extra supply. The Blossoming Promise pack doubles the daily mission rewards and adds Epic rewards.

phases.name: Silverfrost Shop
phases.description: The exchange hub. Destiny Points come from commissions and from packs in Petals of Desire, and unlock milestone rewards in the shop. Silver Shells come from Petals of Desire daily missions and Silver Shell Packs, and buy limited-time items. Progress clears when the event ends and unclaimed rewards are mailed.

phases.name: Bloom Battle
phases.description: The Rosarion appears at random in the Wilderness and seizes roses. Defeat it to protect the roses. You get 5 attacks each day on the Rosarion, and unused attacks do not carry over. Each attack gives Rosarion Attack Rewards and points by damage. Points reset daily and rewards are sent the next day by that day’s points ranking.

rewards.name: Flower Points
rewards.note: Unlock rewards in Petals of Desire

rewards.name: Destiny Points
rewards.note: Unlock milestone rewards in the Silverfrost Shop

rewards.name: Silver Shell
rewards.note: Exchange for limited-time items in the Silverfrost Shop

tips: Complete the daily missions every day to get as many Flower Points, Destiny Points, and Silver Shells as you can.
Join Bloom Battle for extra rewards.
Spend your event currencies before the event ends.
The reward track and shop amounts are shown on the wiki only as images.
